items.stem: Which Power Automate action lets a flow pause until an approver responds before continuing?

options.text: Start and wait for an approval
options.rationale: Correct: this action pauses the flow until the approval is resolved.
Sending email notifies someone but does not wait for an approval decision.
This retrieves a manager but does not wait for approval.
Compose stores a value and does not handle approvals.

items.explanation: Correct: 'Start and wait for an approval' pauses the flow until the approval is resolved.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO statements about sending an approval to a Microsoft 365 group with 'First to respond' are correct? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Only one member of the group needs to respond
options.rationale: Correct: with first-to-respond, a single member's response represents the group.

options.text: The group must be mail-enabled to receive email notifications
options.rationale: Correct: only mail-enabled groups receive the email notification.

options.text: Every member of the group must approve
options.rationale: Incorrect: that would be an 'Everyone must respond' pattern, not first-to-respond.

options.text: Teams notifications are sent to the whole group
options.rationale: Incorrect: Teams notifications are not sent for group approvals.

items.explanation: Correct: one member can respond for the group, and the group must be mail-enabled for email notifications.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: After an approval resolves, what is the purpose of adding a Condition action on the approver response?

options.text: To run different actions depending on whether the request was approved or rejected
options.rationale: Correct: a condition branches the flow based on the response.

options.text: To pause the flow a second time
options.rationale: A condition does not wait; it branches.
The approval action, not a condition, creates the request.
Connection is handled by the connector, not a condition.

items.explanation: Correct: a condition branches the flow based on whether the request was approved or rejected.
